description: Maritime Mobile Service Identity, the identifier for AIS
name: mmsi

description: year
name: year

description: Flag State (ISO3 value) for the vessel as determined by the first three digits (MID) of the MMSI number
name: flag_ais

description: Flag State (ISO3 value) for the vessel as listed on vessel registries (when applicable)
name: flag_registry

description: Flag state (ISO3 value) assigned to the vessel by GFW after considering all available information
name: flag_gfw

description: Vessel class (geartype) inferred by the GFW vessel classification neural net model
name: vessel_class_inferred

description: Neural net score (0-1) for the top scoring vessel class inferred by the GFW vessel classification neural net model. Values closer to 1 indicate higher confidence by the neural net
name: vessel_class_inferred_score

description: Vessel class (geartype) for the vessel as listed on vessel registries (if applicable)
name: vessel_class_registry

description: Vessel class (geartype) assigned to the vessel by GFW after considering all available information
name: vessel_class_gfw

description: Whether the vessel broadcasts the 'Fishing' ship type in > 98% of AIS identity messages
name: self_reported_fishing_vessel

description: Vessel length (meters) inferred by the GFW vessel classification neural net model
name: length_m_inferred

description: Vessel length (meters) for the vessel as listed on vessel registries (if applicable)
name: length_m_registry

description: Vessel length (meters) assigned to the vessel by GFW after considering all available information
name: length_m_gfw

description: Engine power (kilowatts) inferred by the GFW vessel classification neural net model
name: engine_power_kw_inferred

description: Engine power (kilowatts) for the vessel as listed on vessel registries (if applicable)
name: engine_power_kw_registry

description: Engine power (kilowatts) assigned to the vessel by GFW after considering all available information
name: engine_power_kw_gfw

description: Tonnage (gross tons) inferred by the GFW vessel classification neural net model
name: tonnage_gt_inferred

description: Tonnage (gross tons) for the vessel as listed on vessel registries
name: tonnage_gt_registry

description: Tonnage (gross tons) assigned to the vessel by GFW after considering all available information
name: tonnage_gt_gfw

description: Registries where the vessel is listed and used to inform the _registry fields (if applicable)
name: registries_listed

description: Hours the vessel was broadcasting AIS and moving faster than 0.1 knots
name: active_hours

description: Hours the vessel was broadcasting AIS and detected as fishing by the GFW fishing detection neural net model
name: fishing_hours
